case.title: The user is redirected to the personal account Page when they try to open the Sign In Page via a direct link
User can sign in with valid username and password values

custom.preconds:
-Registered user with a username exists

-User is logged out
custom.steps:
1. Open the Sign In page

2. Enter a valid registered username in "Email" field

3. Enter a valid password in "Password" field

4. Click [Sign In]
custom.expected: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the personal Main page

case.title: User can sign in with valid email and password values

custom.steps:
1. Open the Sign In page
2. Enter a valid registered email in "Email" field
3. Enter a valid password in "Password" field
4. Click [Sign In]
custom.expected: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the Main page
